James says to count it all joy when you meet trials. How can trials produce steadfastness in you?
If anyone lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously. What do you need wisdom for?
Every good and perfect gift is from above. What good gifts can you thank God for?
Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. What have you heard from God that you need to do?
James warns against showing favouritism to the rich. Who might you be tempted to treat as less important?
"Mercy triumphs over judgement." Where do you need to show mercy?
Faith without works is dead. How does your faith show itself in action?
Abraham and Rahab showed their faith by what they did. Whose example inspires you?
James compares the tongue to a small rudder or spark. How do your words steer your life?
From the same mouth come blessing and cursing. How can you guard your words?
James warns of bitter jealousy and selfish ambition. Where might these be hiding in your heart?
James describes the wisdom from above as pure, peaceable and gentle. Which quality do you need most?
God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble. Where do you need to humble yourself?
"Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you." What would drawing near to God look like today?
James says do not speak evil against one another. How can your words build up rather than tear down?
James says we should say, "If the Lord wills." How do you hold your plans before God?
James warns the rich who withheld wages. How can you treat others fairly with your money?
Be patient like the farmer waiting for the rain. What are you waiting on God for?
Let your "yes" be yes. Why does honesty matter so much?
James says to pray when suffering, sing when cheerful and pray for one another. Who can you pray for today?
James speaks of bringing back someone who wanders from the truth. Is there someone you could gently reach out to?
